capabilities: sort unordered lists in ascending or descending natural order
group list items under letter headings (## A, ## B) to build glossaries
configure sorting per file through YAML frontmatter or plugin settings
sort a selected list from the editor context menu
extras: Not yet in Obsidian's Community Plugins; currently installable via BRAT or manually. Supports English and French, and the author asks for issue reports in English.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to sort the items of an unordered list, so long lists in notes, inventories, and glossaries stay unordered or must be sorted manually.

relations.evidence: Huge thanks to Jesse Hines for the wdio-obsidian-service, which allowed me to run automated tests

summary: Natural-order sorter for unordered Markdown lists, with optional letter-heading grouping for glossaries, run via commands or context menu.
